MRI Information
The Kestrel Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. A person with the Kestrel Vena Cava Filter may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Kestrel Vena Cava Filter
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 and 3 Tesla
Type of Nuclei 31P (phosphorus)
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1.5 W/kg
Scan Duration at 3T: Scan for up to 20 minutes. Followed by a wait time of 30 minutes.
